18280-enter-bridget.title: Enter Bridget
18280-enter-bridget.creator: Unknown
18280-enter-bridget.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. as heralded by Mark Driver one evening towards the end of March, when he had accepted an invitation to dine with his sister and Lawrence in Charteris Street, S.W. Carrissima's maid found her so exacting that evening, that she might have been going to an important party, instead of merely to a quiet dinner with her brother and his wife; but then, expecting Mark to make a fourth, she wished to look her very best, and flattered herself she had succeeded.

arxiv-2201-00883.title: Finite-Element Domain Approximation for Maxwell Variational Problems on Curved Domains
arxiv-2201-00883.creator: Rubén Aylwin, Carlos Jerez-Hanckes
arxiv-2201-00883.description: Abstract 1 Introduction We consider the problem of domain approximation in finite element methods for Maxwell’s equations on curved domains, i.e., when affine or polynomial meshes fail to cover the domain of interest exactly, forcing to approximate the domain by a sequence of (potentially curved) polyhedra arising from inexact meshes.

arxiv-2308-06272.title: Beyond Reality: The Pivotal Role of Generative AI in the Metaverse
arxiv-2308-06272.creator: Vinay Chamola, Senior Member, IEEE, Gaurang Bansal, Tridib Kumar Das, Vikas Hassija, Naga Siva Sai Reddy
arxiv-2308-06272.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Vinay Chamola, Senior Member, IEEE, Gaurang Bansal, Tridib Kumar Das, Vikas Hassija, Naga Siva Sai Reddy. Imagine stepping into a virtual world that’s as rich, dynamic, and interactive as our physical one. This is the promise of the Metaverse, and it’s being brought to life by the transformative power of Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI). This paper offers a comprehensive exploration of how generative AI technologies are shaping the Metaverse, transforming it into a dynamic, immersive, and interactive virtual world.

arxiv-2411-06523.creator: Shayla Sharmin, Md. Fahim Abrar, Roghayeh Leila Barmaki
arxiv-2411-06523.description: Abstract . Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a non-invasive optical technique that measures brain activity by estimating blood oxygenation using near-infrared light. Traditionally, PsychoPy is used in many studies to send task-specific markers, requiring a separate device to interface with the fNIRS data collection system.

arxiv-2412-20700.title: Optimal rolling of fair dice using fair coins
arxiv-2412-20700.creator: Mark Huber, Danny Vargas
arxiv-2412-20700.description: Abstract In 1976, Knuth and Yao presented an algorithm for sampling from a finite distribution using flips of a fair coin that on average used the optimal number of flips. Here we show how to easily run their algorithm for the special case of rolling a fair die that uses memory linear in the input.

arxiv-2502-04317.title: Factorized Implicit Global Convolution for Automotive Computational Fluid Dynamics Prediction
arxiv-2502-04317.creator: Chris Choy, Alexey Kamenev, Jean Kossaifi, Max Rietmann Jan Kautz, Kamyar Azizzadenesheli
arxiv-2502-04317.description: Abstract Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is crucial for automotive design, requiring the analysis of large 3D point clouds to study how vehicle geometry affects pressure fields and drag forces. However, existing deep learning approaches for CFD struggle with the computational complexity of processing high-resolution 3D data.

arxiv-2504-00210.title: Deterministic quantum trajectory via imaginary time evolution
arxiv-2504-00210.creator: Shivan Mittal, Bin Yan
arxiv-2504-00210.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shivan Mittal, Bin Yan. Stochastic quantum trajectories, such as pure state evolutions under unitary dynamics and random measurements, offer a crucial ensemble description of many-body open system dynamics. Recent studies have highlighted that individual quantum trajectories also encode essential physical information. Prominent examples include measurement-induced phase transitions, where a pure quantum state corresponding to fixed measurement outcomes (trajectories) exhibits distinct entanglement phases, depending on the measurement rate.

arxiv-2504-05301.title: 𝐒 𝟒 ​ 𝐌 \mathbf{S^{4}M} : Boosting Semi-Supervised Instance Segmentation with SAM
arxiv-2504-05301.creator: Heeji Yoon, Heeseong Shin, Eunbeen Hong, Hyunwook Choi, Hansang Cho, Daun Jeong, Seungryong Kim
arxiv-2504-05301.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Heeji Yoon, Heeseong Shin, Eunbeen Hong, Hyunwook Choi, Hansang Cho, Daun Jeong, Seungryong Kim. Semi-supervised instance segmentation poses challenges due to limited labeled data, causing difficulties in accurately localizing distinct object instances. Current teacher-student frameworks still suffer from performance constraints due to unreliable pseudo-label quality stemming from limited labeled data. While the Segment Anything Model (SAM) offers robust segmentation capabilities at various granularities, directly applying SAM to this task introduces challenges such as class-agnostic predictions and potential over-segmentation.

arxiv-2511-19193.title: Bound states for systems with quartic energy-momentum dispersion
arxiv-2511-19193.creator: E.V. Gorbar, B.E. Grinyuk, V.P. Gusynin
arxiv-2511-19193.description: Abstract Bound states and its energies for systems with the quartic energy-momentum dispersion E ⁡ ( p ) ∼ p 4 E(p)\sim p^{4} and polynomial potentials are studied using the Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin (WKB) semiclassical approximation and the Wentzel complex method taking into account higher order WKB corrections.

europmc-pmc1964804.creator: Lombardo MV, Barnes JL, Wheelwright SJ, Baron-Cohen S.
europmc-pmc1964804.description: Background Individuals with autism spectrum conditions (ASC) have profound impairments in the interpersonal social domain, but it is unclear if individuals with ASC also have impairments in the intrapersonal self-referential domain. We aimed to evaluate across several well valid

pmc-10649885.title: Anisotropy in the Liquefaction Resistance of Fibre Reinforced Sand
pmc-10649885.creator: Xidong Zhang, Yan Zhuang, Zhen’ang Wang, Changxing Yang, Shunlei Hu, Krzysztof Schabowicz
pmc-10649885.description: Adding discrete fibres to sand has been seen as a feasible technique to improve sand’s strength as well as liquefaction resistance. Considering the anisotropic distribution of fibre orientations, the anisotropy in the liquefaction resistance of the reinforced sand is also introduced using fibres.

pmc-11548514.title: PDeT: A Progressive Deformable Transformer for Photovoltaic Panel Defect Segmentation
pmc-11548514.creator: Peng Zhou, Hong Fang, Gaochang Wu
pmc-11548514.description: Defects in photovoltaic (PV) panels can significantly reduce the power generation efficiency of the system and may cause localized overheating due to uneven current distribution. Therefore, adopting precise pixel-level defect detection, i.e., defect segmentation, technology is essential to ensuring stable operation.

pmc-12450371.title: Toxic dinoflagellate Prorocentrum cordatum affects the filtration rate and enzymatic activities of Chinese razor clam (Sinonovacula constricta)
pmc-12450371.creator: Yanbin Tang, Zhibing Jiang, Yibo Liao, Lu Shou, Jiangning Zeng, Rongliang Zhang, Chenghua Li
pmc-12450371.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Harmful algal blooms represent a significant environmental challenge in various marine ecosystems worldwide. While marine filter-feeder bivalves can consume toxic phytoplankton, their capacity to mitigate the presence of harmful microalgae is not yet fully understood. In this study, we examined the filtration rates and enzymatic activities of Sinonovacula constricta, a commercially valuable bivalve, when exposed to varying levels of toxic dinoflagellates (Prorocentrum cordatum) and non-toxic diatoms (Skeletonema costatum) over a 12-h period.

pmc-12523033.title: Molecular characterization of a unique Recombinant form of HIV-1 subtype F2/CRF02_AG identified in Guangdong, China
pmc-12523033.creator: Xuemei Ling, Yaqing Lin, Linghua Li, Junbin Li, Liting Zhang, Xizi Deng, Wenfang Luo, Jinwang Shi, Jiaojiao Li, Haisheng Yu, Fengyu Hu, Yun Lan
pmc-12523033.description: BackgroundThe human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1) pandemic continues to pose a significant global public health challenge. Recombination between HIV-1 variants generates unique recombinant forms (URFs) and then circulating recombinant forms (CRFs) after ongoing transmission. Subtype F2 and CRF02_AG mainly spread in western Africa, but they are rarely detected in China.

pmc-12786085.title: Proteomic Analysis of Streptococcus suis During Exposure to Intracellular Condition of Human Macrophage U937 Cells
pmc-12786085.creator: Peerarin Prangsuwan, Orathai Yinsai, Sittiruk Roytrakul, Kwanjit Duangsonk
pmc-12786085.description: Streptococcus suis is an important zoonotic pathogen responsible for severe infections in pigs and humans. Its capacity to survive within phagocytic cells is considered a key virulence mechanism that contributes to dissemination and persistence in host tissues. This study employed comparative proteomic profiling to investigate intracellular adaptation of S.

pmc-13141164.title: Maraviroc for Stroke Recovery (MASTER): protocol for a phase 2 double-blind placebo-controlled randomised clinical trial
pmc-13141164.creator: Nicolas Broc, Gabriel Byczynski, Elisabeth Dirren, Emmanuel Carrera
pmc-13141164.description: IntroductionDespite advances in acute treatment, stroke remains the first cause of acquired disability. Today, there is no effective pharmacological therapy to improve recovery beyond the acute phase. Preclinical studies suggest that inhibition of the C-C chemokine Receptor 5 (CCR5) may promote recovery by enhancing plasticity in the peri-infarct cortex.

pmc-13186859.title: Component Clinical and Cost Outcomes Complementing Value of Information: Case Study of a Tuberculosis Diagnostics Clinical Trial
pmc-13186859.creator: Pamela Pei, Livia Qoshe, Grady Florance, Ankur Pandya, Milton C. Weinstein, Kenneth A. Freedberg, A. David Paltiel, Krishna P. Reddy
pmc-13186859.description: PurposeConventional value-of-information (VOI) analysis bases decisions on a composite cost-effectiveness measure that aggregates clinical and cost outcomes. We sought to highlight potentially informative tradeoffs by estimating and reporting the “disaggregated” components, allowing stakeholders—such as clinicians, patients, trial funders, policymakers, and trial networks—to identify what drives the value of additional research.

pmc-13223547.title: Patient-Reported Outcomes in FLAURA2: Osimertinib with or without Chemotherapy in Patients with Previously Untreated EGFR-Mutated Advanced Non–Small Cell Lung Cancer
pmc-13223547.creator: Jhanelle E. Gray, Konstantin Laktionov, Sang-We Kim, Terufumi Kato, Jialei Wang, Zhigang Han, Paul Mitchell, Shoichi Kuyama, Jerry Tan Chun Bing, Juan Cundom, Gustavo Pinto, Frances A. Shepherd, Lynne Poole, Rachel Lai, Muna Albayaty, Neha P. Amin, Kunihiko Kobayashi, Chee Khoon Lee
pmc-13223547.description: Purpose:In FLAURA2, first-line osimertinib plus platinum–pemetrexed induction, with osimertinib plus pemetrexed maintenance, improved progression-free survival versus osimertinib alone in epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)-mutated, advanced non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC; hazard ratio, 0.62; P < 0.001). Combining osimertinib with chemotherapy increased induction grade ≥3 adverse event rates, which reduced during maintenance. We report FLAURA2 patient-reported outcomes (PRO).

pmc-13241583.title: Complex History of Organellar Introgression in Nothofagus Trees: Chloroplast and Mitochondrial Capture Facilitated by Natural Selection
pmc-13241583.creator: Gabriela Narváez, Marie‐Laure Guillemin, Francisco Sepúlveda‐Espinoza, Daly Noll, Rodrigo A. Gutiérrez, Verónica Arana, Nicolás Bellora, Francisco A. Cubillos, Juliana A. Vianna
pmc-13241583.description: Hybridization is widespread across diverse groups of organisms, and in some cases, organellar genomes of one species become fixed in another following hybridization and backcrossing, a phenomenon known as organelle capture. Because cytoplasmic genomes can contribute to local adaptation, organelle capture has the potential to confer a selective advantage and may be maintained by natural selection.

pmc-13461165.title: CRISPR/Cas9 loss-of-function screen in a neuronal model of AP-4 deficiency identifies ATG9A trafficking modulators
pmc-13461165.creator: Marvin Ziegler, Cedric Günter, Julian E Alecu, Xutong Xue, Hyo M Kim, Afshin Saffari, Alexandra K Davies, Mustafa Sahin, Darius Ebrahimi-Fakhari
pmc-13461165.description: Biallelic loss-of-function variants in adaptor protein complex 4 (AP-4) disrupt trafficking of transmembrane proteins at the trans-Golgi network, including autophagy-related protein 9A (ATG9A), leading to childhood-onset hereditary spastic paraplegia (AP-4-HSP). AP-4-HSP is characterized by features of both a neurodevelopmental and a degenerative neurological disease.

pmc-13516546.title: Special Issue “Metformin: Mechanism and Application 2023”
pmc-13516546.creator: Agnieszka Śliwińska
pmc-13516546.description: ell beyond glucose regulation. The articles gathered in this Special Issue reprint reflect the expanding scope of metformin research, encompassing its pharmacokinetics, molecular mechanisms of action, adverse effects, biomarker discovery, and emerging therapeutic applications in oncology, neurodegenerative diseases, ischemia/reperfusion injury, gestational diabetes mellitus, and complications associated with systemic therapies.

pmc-13549555.title: Global trends in e-cigarette regulatory compliance
pmc-13549555.creator: Ammar Abdulrahman Jairoun, Sabaa Saleh Al-Hemyari, Moyad Shahwan, Abeer M. Al-Ghananeem, Sa’ed H. Zyoud, Brian Godman
pmc-13549555.description: Background:Electronic cigarettes, commonly referred to as e-cigarettes, have spread rapidly across global markets. Their growth has created regulatory concerns involving product safety, nicotine levels, youth access, advertising practices, flavor controls, and protection of public health. Countries have adopted different regulatory approaches because of variation in public health priorities, tobacco-control policies, and legal systems.
